Name: World Map Update for Boarding House (Vibrant Pastoral Recolor)
Author: waterscapes
Description:
This is a mod to match the in-game map addition for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120]Boarding House[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]. 

There are two different files to download, please make sure to download the one that matches the fall color you are using! 

How to Install: 

1. Drag the zBoardingHouse folder in your Mods folder. 
2. Click "Replace the file in the destination".

I received permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60742951]TrentXV[/url] to make this.
